views.label: Plan + provider
views.note: The plan names the user's cloud ASR config and speaker detector; a model with no timestamps is refused before dispatch.

views.label: Speakers onto text
views.note: Vendor labels are used as-is; a parallel diarizer's turns are merged by assign_speakers at word or segment granularity.

views.label: Voiceprints for cloud audio
views.note: After any cloud detector, voiceprints are computed on this server (cpu queue); vendor voiceprints are never used.

cards.title: Who detects the speakers
items: inline_asr: the transcription vendor's own labels (tasks/transcription/cloud_asr.py)
parallel_cloud: pyannote.ai, or another saved provider through services/diarization/asr_adapter.py (its text is discarded, it bills a full transcription)
Automatic + a text-only model: this server after transcription on the full image; refused on lite

cards.title: Timing decides the merge
items: word: each word gets the overlapping speaker; segment: each segment does and its words follow
none (gpt-4o-transcribe): refused with asr_no_timing_for_speakers; there is no forced alignment
A cloud plan never falls back to local Whisper; a failed cloud diarizer keeps the text

cards.title: Voiceprints stay local
items: services/voiceprint_extractor.py on the cpu queue (speaker_embedding_task), on full and lite alike
Same matching and clustering downstream as local ASR; see the Speaker Clustering diagram
